plan.title: A founder's plan change is raised as ZOH's question, and the tester's tweak is what's saved

context.text: Two weeks straight, Maya. That's who you are now. Kalinixta 📚

transcript.text: Kalimera Maya! Fourteen days straight with The Overstory, and today is 10 more pages in bed. Here's an idea for your usual plan from now on: move the step from 9 pm to 7:30 pm. Would that work for you?
7:30 is tight with dinner, 8 would be better
Done, Maya: your reading time moves to 8 pm, every day, starting today. Same 10 pages in bed, and I'll still want a photo of the page you stop on.

checks.reason: Framed as 'Here's an idea' from ZOH with no team or founder mention, and asks if it works for her.
Three short sentences with one question at the end.
Three sentences, no question, confirming the 8 pm change from today.

conversation.reason: The 7:30 pm move is raised as ZOH's idea with her OK requested, with no team or founders mentioned.
A time change to the existing reading plan is treated as a change, not an added goal.
The kickoff raised 7:30 as ZOH's idea with one question, and her 8 o'clock reply got a short confirmation of 8 pm starting today with no extra questions.

grade.summary: ZOH handled the regression case well: it raised the 7:30 pm move as its own idea, asked one question, and confirmed her 8 pm tweak briefly without mentioning the team. The only soft spot is the phrase 'from now on' in the kickoff, which is borderline on whether it reads as ZOH's own suggestion.
